title: stajichlab/RelocaTE3 sample sheet
description: One row per sample or lane: sample,fastq_1,fastq_2[,genotype_bam]. Rows sharing a sample name are lanes of one sample.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided, start with a letter or digit and contain only [A-Za-z0-9._-] (it becomes part of file names and commands)

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must end in '.fq', '.fastq', '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must end in '.fq', '.fastq', '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

genotype_bam.errorMessage: Genotype alignment cannot contain spaces and must end in '.bam' or '.cram'
